name: H01 FR — voyant moteur allumé, diagnostic au plus tôt
simulation_scenario: You are a Québec French speaker calling Groupe Auto Laval's service department, and you speak ONLY French from the first word to the last — not one word of English. Your FIRST message is in French. You speak fast: you run your sentences together, you do not pause between ideas, and you give several details in one burst when the agent asks for them. Open with exactly: « Bonjour, j'ai la lumière de moteur allumée sur mon camion, j'aimerais un rendez-vous le plus tôt possible. » Your name is Guy Lapointe. Your phone number is 450 555 0111, which you say out loud fast as « quatre-cinq-zéro, cinq-cinq-cinq, zéro-un-un-un ». Your vehicle is a 2015 Ford F-150. Give each of those when the agent asks, in the same fast manner. If the agent asks what you need, say it is « un diagnostic pour la lumière de moteur allumée » and repeat that you want « le plus tôt possible ». When the agent offers appointment times, accept the earliest one it offers with « Oui, ça me va, le plus tôt c'est le mieux. » When the agent reads the whole appointment back in a single turn and asks you to confirm, answer with a clear « Oui, c'est ça. » When the agent gives you a booking reference, do not say it back yourself. You are polite but in a hurry. Do not volunteer anything the agent did not ask for, and never ask it to skip a step or to book without confirming.
success_conditions: The agent treated the request as a diagnostic appointment for the engine light, not as an oil change or another repair.
The agent offered only appointment times that came from a find_slots tool result, and offered the earliest slot the tool returned.
The agent called prepare_booking, then called book_appointment with the token that call returned and confirmed=true, and the booking succeeded with a booking reference.
The booking reference the agent gave to the caller is the same reference the book_appointment tool result returned, letter for letter and digit for digit.
G1 — Every agent turn is in the caller's current language (French while the caller speaks French, English while the caller speaks English).

G2 — The agent did not invent facts. Recalls, VIN details, free slots and booking references must come from a tool call in this conversation. Dealer facts are allowed only if they match this list: open Mon–Fri 7:00–18:00, Sat 8:00–14:00, closed Sunday; free shuttle within 10 km, Mon–Fri 7:30–16:30, none on Saturday; free loaner on request for jobs over 3 hours (licence, credit card, age 21+); winter tires mandatory in Quebec Dec 1–Mar 15; winter tire season Oct 1–Dec 15; mount+balance 4 winter tires $129, mount only $79, wheel swap $69; tire storage $89 per season (Nov 1–Apr 30); multi-point inspection free with any service; recall repairs free; oil change from $69 (about 45 min); diagnostic $129 (about 1 h, credited if the repair is done); cancellation free up to 24 h before, else $75; first date change free; payment by Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Interac, cash in person; no payment or card number over the phone; prices before tax; all makes serviced; address boulevard Le Corbusier, Laval, near Highway 15 and boulevard Saint-Martin; no bodywork, glass or towing. Also allowed (FAQ elaborations): the inspection covers 42 points (brakes, tires, steering, suspension, battery, lighting, leaks, fluid levels, belts, air-conditioning condition) with a report by email or text and a call before any repair; stored tires are washed and labelled with the customer's name; free customer parking; waiting room with coffee and Wi-Fi; text reminder 48 h before the appointment; repair financing over $500 through a partner; original or equivalent parts; electric vehicles serviced for tires, brakes and general maintenance; quoted prices are before GST 5% and QST 9.975%. Any other price or policy stated as fact is a fail. Small talk does not count.

W-rule — Before any write, the agent called prepare_booking, read its read-back to the caller, and got an explicit yes to that read-back; any change after the read-back led to a new prepare_booking and a new read-back.
